## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, General Information

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
Registration runs through the county clerk within 15 days, while insurance must already cover the car before it rolls [A01].
Why it matters: group general-information; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F01, sec02-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
Split minimums stack $25,000, $50,000, and $25,000 across injury and property lines, while a single $60,000 limit covers everything at once [A01].
Why it matters: group general-information; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
Students keep home-state papers beside a school ID, while troops may title Kentucky cars on out-of-state insurance [A01].
Why it matters: group general-information; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A02
Seizure sufferers count 90 clear days, while vision tests grade 20/60 eyes with wide fields [A02].
Why it matters: group general-information; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F09, sec02-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
Standard drivers need 20/60 in one eye, while bioptic trainees start at 20/200 and reach 20/60 through the device [A02].
Why it matters: group general-information; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F10, sec02-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A03
Physicians, attorneys, clerks, sheriffs, and judges report directly, while citizens must pair up on an affidavit [A03].
Why it matters: group general-information; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0029]
